en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a three‑storey late‑19th‑century building with a mansard roof, central tower-like bay and a date "1896" on the front gable. The ground floor has arched windows on a stone base; the upper floors have rectangular windows with decorative frames. Two large lanterns flank the main entrance, where a uniformed man stands on the steps. In front of the building a dirt square is visible with a man and a handcart; trees frame both sides and low wooden fences line the foreground. A rectangular signboard with German text is mounted on the right side of the facade, suggesting an inn or public building.
